basis: The map's legend explicitly encodes incidence from dark red (Low, 0) to pale yellow (High, 100). Texas (TX) is filled pale yellow, indicating the highest incidence. Washington (WA) is filled dark red, indicating the lowest incidence. Colorado (CO) is filled dark red, indicating the lowest incidence. The task requires routing to the jurisdiction with the highest incidence among the candidates. Texas is the only candidate with a color corresponding to the highest incidence level (pale yellow).
option_label: Open Texas (TX) incidence profile for follow-up routing
